source_fields.instance: The complete data and row order of an arbitrary real matrix $A\in\mathbb R^{m\times n}$ are fixed in advance. Each n-dimensional row arrives once.

assumptions.description: Fixed input order; the entire data sequence is chosen before play begins.

source_fields.parameter_domain_description: Require m,n ≥ 1, 1 ≤ k < min(m,n), ε > 0, and one pass. Low input rank is not assumed.

operations.query_signature: Receive arrival i in the fixed order; the algorithm does not submit a numerical query vector.
operations.response_signature: The full current row a_iᵀ contains n exact input entries. It arrives once and cannot be reread.
operations.order_convention: Native matrix access; no scalar derivative order is assigned.
operations.coupling: The complete input and row order are fixed before the private seed is drawn. Future data do not adapt to algorithm state.
operations.index_control: Rows cannot be selected, reordered, or revisited; only the stored state can be updated.
operations.access_schedule: one pass, fixed row order, no past requery

source_fields.query_domain_description: There is no selectable query vector. The next row is received passively, with no Av or Aᵀu channel.

source_fields.feasibility: Return a basis or finite description of a right rank-$k$ subspace, defining a rank-$k$ orthogonal projection $P\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$. The product $AP$ need not be output.
source_fields.allowed_postprocessing: Decode the output only from the final state and public parameters. Do not reread the input or recover discarded rows from an output medium.
source_fields.certificate_requirement: Only the true-loss guarantee is required; no computable certificate is requested.

source_fields.normalization: If both numerator and denominator are zero, the loss is zero. A zero denominator with nonzero numerator gives +∞. Otherwise use the stated ratio.
source_fields.finiteness_conditions: The specified dimension is finite, and the model and spectral assumptions hold.

components.description: Peak number of simultaneously stored real numbers
Real arithmetic operations in the implementation; the current memory quantity does not charge them.
Each row can be read only once

source_fields.budget_semantics: One pass; peak memory is bounded for every input and random seed.
source_fields.scalarization: Record one pass, peak real-register memory, total arithmetic work, and $m$ stream rows separately.
source_fields.setup_cost: An external stream supplies rows sequentially. All information retained across rows counts as working state, and the output is decoded only from the final state.
source_fields.online_cost: One pass, with input rows arriving sequentially
source_fields.precision_model: Inputs and internal registers are exact real numbers; no finite-precision error guarantee is supplied.

view_override_policy.limitations: Mechanical merge does not certify consistency or mathematical identity. Narrative qualifications and source conditions remain authoritative.

source_fields.adaptivity: The state may depend on past inputs; the input order cannot be chosen.
source_fields.internal_computation: Use the exact-real numerical linear algebra model. Count simultaneously stored real registers and record the verified algorithm's arithmetic cost separately. Arbitrary uncomputable encodings cannot compress the entire input at no cost.
source_fields.parallelism: Sequential row arrivals, with no free parallel copies.

source_fields.complete_expression: For every row stream fixed in advance, the squared residual is at most (1+epsilon) times the optimal squared residual with probability at least 2/3. Zero optimal residual requires exact recovery.
source_fields.quantifier_order: exists algorithm; for every fixed input; Pr_seed(success)>=2/3

oracle.query_domain_description: There is no selectable query vector. The next row is received passively, with no Av or Aᵀu channel.
oracle.description_zh: The quantity $m,n,k,\varepsilon$ is public. Each call returns only the next complete row. Consumed rows are unavailable again, and the algorithm cannot query $Av$ or reread the input after the stream ends.
description_paragraphs: The quantity $m,n,k,\varepsilon$ is public. Each call returns only the next complete row. Consumed rows are unavailable again, and the algorithm cannot query $Av$ or reread the input after the stream ends.

output.feasibility: Return a basis or finite description of a right rank-$k$ subspace, defining a rank-$k$ orthogonal projection $P\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$. The product $AP$ need not be output.
output.allowed_postprocessing: Decode the output only from the final state and public parameters. Do not reread the input or recover discarded rows from an output medium.
output.certificate_requirement: Only the true-loss guarantee is required; no computable certificate is requested.
output.description_zh: After the stream ends, use only the retained final state to output $P=P^{\mathsf T}=P^2\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$ and $\operatorname{rank}(P)=k$. An orthonormal-basis representation is acceptable. Outputting $AP$ is not required.
description_paragraphs: After the stream, use only retained state to output $P=P^{\mathsf T}=P^2\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ with $\operatorname{rank}(P)=k$; an orthonormal-basis representation is allowed. Returning $AP$ is unnecessary.

metric.normalization: If both numerator and denominator are zero, the loss is zero. A zero denominator with nonzero numerator gives +∞. Otherwise use the stated ratio.
metric.finiteness_conditions: The specified dimension is finite, and the model and spectral assumptions hold.
metric.description_zh: Let $A_k$ be any best rank-$k$ Frobenius approximation. Success requires $\|A(I_n-P)\|_{\mathrm F}^2\le(1+\varepsilon)\|A-A_k\|_{\mathrm F}^2$; the residual is explicitly squared. When the optimal residual is zero, the row space must be recovered exactly.

resource.description_zh:
The resource is the maximum number $S_{\mathbb R}$ of simultaneously retained exact-real registers. One pass is fixed by the protocol, arithmetic is uncharged, and register bit precision is unspecified.

The cap holds for every input and random seed. Decode the final output from charged state without undeclared external storage.
description_paragraphs: The native resource is the maximum number $S_{\mathbb R}$ of simultaneously retained exact real registers. One pass is fixed by the protocol, and arithmetic is free. No bit width per register is specified.
The cost limit holds for every input and private seed. The final output must be decoded from the charged state, without an unregistered external cache.
